shots.text: At Elderhollow the Pale Vesper fell. She had been a Veilwalker singer who sang at funerals. She too had gone to the Rift two years ago. Before she died, the grey went out of her eyes.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Pale Vesper falling among the roots, her ghost-choir scattering like moths.

shots.text:
The Marshal sent us to the Rift. Six of us. Study the Gate, he said...

He knew what was behind it.
shots.speaker: pale_vesper
shots.art_note: Close on the Vesper's face, the grey light leaving her eyes; for a moment she looks like herself.

shots.text: Cassivane was my Marshal and my friend. I did not believe her. I thought it was the Hollow talking.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ysolde in the Hall of the Ring reading a messenger's report, then folding it away.

shots.text: In the root-halls we found Sylvaine Thornwhisper, the Deepwood's best archer. She had held the root-doors alone while the whole town climbed out.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Sylvaine Thornwhisper standing amid a ring of fallen hollow things, a pale leafing longbow in her hands, moss cloak. She lowers the bow.

shots.text: They're all out. Every child. Now show me where to stand.
shots.speaker: sylvaine
shots.art_note: Sylvaine at the edge of a tower platform, arrow on the string. Joins as a hero.
